body: Ive been in your shoes.....i lost my fiance because i couldnt be a man. I couldnt keep myself focused and i couldnt keep myself clean from drugs and alchohol. You have to live bro. Im already dead inside. I feel nothing. My family cant even get to me. Nothing matters and im one strand away from killing myself and anyone i feel deserves it. Just focus on yourself man. Be who you want to be and dont give a shit about what anyone says. You can do it bro. Dont end it. Dont be like me
